 I kept coming back to one picture: someone is live, headphones on, and an assistant is trying to feed them a line. That only works if the assistant cannot make things up, and if the person can still say no,
I almost built a research board instead. Cool idea. Too much canvas, not enough time, built the room we could actually finish, a producer desk you can see the rundown. You can see what the agent just tried. You decide what goes on air.
That is the whole point of this challenge for me. Not a smarter chatbot. A page two people can share — one of them happens to be an agent.
